options.TargetLayer: The name or selection of the layer to turn off

gotchas: Cannot turn off the current active layer - switch to a different layer first
If the specified layer is already off, the command will have no visible effect
Layer names are case-sensitive when specified directly

-SelObjectsOnLayer.description: Selects all objects that exist on a specified layer.

default.dialogue: Minimal - prompts for layer name if not specified
default.description: Select all objects on the specified layer

options.layer_name: Name of the layer whose objects should be selected - can be typed directly or chosen from list

gotchas: Layer name must exist in the document - misspelled layer names will result in no selection
Hidden or locked objects on the layer will not be selected
Current layer visibility settings affect which objects can be selected

-Trim.description: Trims objects by removing portions that extend beyond cutting boundaries, with inverted selection behavior compared to standard Trim.

default.dialogue: Select cutting objects
default.description: Standard negative trim operation with default settings

no_cutting_objects.description: Trim operation without using cutting objects

options.CuttingObjects: Controls whether cutting objects are used (Yes/No) - when No, allows trimming without cutting boundaries

gotchas: The negative (-) prefix inverts the selection behavior compared to standard Trim
When CuttingObjects=No, the trimming behavior changes significantly
Command may behave differently than expected if you're used to the standard Trim command

-Fillet.description: Creates rounded transitions (fillets) between intersecting edges, curves, or surfaces with a specified radius.

radius.description: Set fillet radius and then select edges to fillet

options.Radius: Sets the radius of the fillet - the distance from the original corner to the curved edge
options.Join: Controls whether filleted surfaces are joined together (Yes/No)
options.Trim: Controls whether original edges are trimmed away (Yes/No)
options.BlendType: Specifies the type of blend surface created

gotchas: Must set radius before selecting edges - command won't work without a radius value
Fillet radius cannot be larger than the smallest dimension of the geometry being filleted
Complex intersections may fail - try smaller radius or different approach
Join=No leaves separate fillet surfaces that may need manual joining later

-Chamfer.description: Creates beveled edges by cutting corners at specified distances along adjacent surfaces.

distances.dialogue: Sets different chamfer distances for each side of the edge
distances.description: Allows asymmetric chamfers with different distances on each adjacent surface

options.Distances: Set different chamfer distances for each side of an edge
options.Distance: Set a single uniform chamfer distance for both sides
options.Angle: Define chamfer by distance and angle instead of two distances

gotchas: Command sets chamfer parameters first, then prompts for edge selection - don't expect immediate results
Chamfer distances are measured along the adjacent surfaces, not as the chamfer width
Very small or very large distances relative to edge length may fail or produce unexpected results
Chamfers may fail on edges where the specified distances exceed available surface area
